analysis:
Examined ProviderLoop+InboundDecode.swift (head) and the InferenceHandler patch and base text. Decode: decodeOpenAIRequest is split into repairedRequestBody and decodeRepairedOpenAIRequest with the same logic (the var-to-let change is cosmetic). The new decodeInboundChatRequest passes no modelType, matching the previous handler call to decodeOpenAIRequest(decryptedData), so the GLM raw-schema path is not newly reachable. The single-parse fast path runs only when repair leaves the bytes unchanged. A failed InboundChatRequest decode (try?) falls through to the strict and normalization path, and extensions are taken from the original bytes, as before. InboundChatExtensions reuses the earlier independent per-field try? probes, so a malformed field still cannot discard the others. Rejection logs are unchanged and do not interpolate decode errors (prompt-privacy invariant retained). The reserved tool-schema metadata rejection at base line 320 still precedes decode.

Admission: awaitReleasedLoads (otherThan/of) adds suspension points before fastAdmissionReject, and one more after a rejection. They sit before the authoritative drain/MTP/autopilot re-checks and before requestToModel registration, so the atomic drain-versus-registration property (base lines 468-515) is preserved. releaseWorkFIFO now fires after acceptance and registration, before ensureModelLoaded, for cold non-mimo_v2 loads. This lets later events, including cancel, proceed without queuing behind a cold load. Cancellation is already registered at that point, so T-010 behavior should hold.

Not verifiable from the supplied evidence: ProviderLoop+WorkFIFO.swift (WorkFIFOGate, awaitReleasedLoads, releaseWorkFIFO) and the caller that supplies workFIFOGate. Open questions are whether concurrent cold loads can still exceed memory or capacity caps (availability, T-029/T-016-type DoS), whether a gate is always released on every early-return path, and whether any cache-scope or A-001 handling is affected. No encryption, key, cache-scope or attestation code is changed. No concrete regression is identified.
